name: mirage
text: Not sure what 'it' and 'done' refer to, so here is where DG5 (the Tracker rebuild on Novig wallet data) stands: planned and logged in 4 steps, nothing built or released yet. Step 1, the engine pulling Novig's fills and ledger into a permanent GitHub file, is next. The old Tracker data stays until the new source is confirmed correct, so you never see an empty or wrong Tracker in between. If you meant something else, tell me which and I'll answer it.
